summary: Orchestra BioMed filed an 8-K under Items 7.01 and 8.01 disclosing that, as of September 30, 2026, 330 patients had been randomized in the BACKBEAT Global Pivotal Trial, exceeding its previously announced target of 316. The trial evaluates AVIM Therapy in pacemaker-indicated patients with uncontrolled hypertension, conducted with Medtronic at 81 sites across 13 countries, with 284 evaluable subjects specified for the FDA-approved primary endpoint analysis. This is a routine clinical milestone, not a special situation. Trial readout timing and regulatory filing prospects are the watch items.
